question: The Ashoka Chakra Class-II was renamed as ______ in 1967.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kirti Chakra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Before 1967,** Kirti Chakra** was known as** Ashok Chakra, Class II.**
 
• **The Kirti Chakra **is an Indian military decoration given for gallantry, bravery, or self-sacrifice off the battlefield.</li&
